novel_features.name: Enriched shop view
novel_features.description: List filters joined with their categories — name, price, stock (in / backorder / out) — sorted by price.
novel_features.rationale: Joins WooCommerce products with categories locally; offline after sync.
novel_features.why_it_matters: Use to scan the filter catalog with prices and categories in one view.

novel_features.name: Variant explorer
novel_features.description: List a variable product's WooCommerce variations — variation id, attributes, price, stock — invisible via wp-json/wp/v2.
novel_features.rationale: wp/v2 only exposes parent products; the Store API's variation ids are resolved per-variant for price and availability.
novel_features.why_it_matters: Use to get the exact variation_id and stock for a size (e.g. 82mm vs 95mm adapter ring) before building cart links.

novel_features.name: Filter finder
novel_features.description: Discover available filter sizes/types from product attributes and find matching products.
novel_features.rationale: Correlates global attributes with each product's attribute values in the local store — a cross-product view no storefront endpoint returns.
novel_features.why_it_matters: Reach for this to answer 'which sizes exist' or 'which products are 82mm' without clicking the storefront.

novel_features.name: Agent-clean reader
novel_features.description: Print one post, page, or product as title plus plain-text content, stripping the WordPress envelope.
novel_features.rationale: Collapses yoast_head, jetpack_*, class_list and _links into a bounded, agent-sized view from the local store.
novel_features.why_it_matters: Use to read Academy guides without burning context on WordPress envelope fields.

novel_features.name: Catalog and site digest
novel_features.description: Summarize the mirror: product count, price range, in-stock vs out, top categories, and content counts.
novel_features.rationale: A cross-entity aggregation over the local store that no upstream endpoint provides.
novel_features.why_it_matters: Use for a one-shot overview of the catalog and site without paging every collection.

novel_features.name: Recently changed
novel_features.description: List posts and pages modified within a time window, across those types at once.
novel_features.rationale: Time-windowed scan of locally-stored modified timestamps; the API has no unified recently-changed endpoint. (Store API products lack timestamps, so they are excluded.)
novel_features.why_it_matters: Use to answer 'what is new on the site' without checking each collection separately.

novel_features.name: Image resolver
novel_features.description: Resolve the featured image of a post or page, or a product's inline images, to full-resolution URLs.
novel_features.rationale: The source entity only stores a media ID; resolving it requires the locally-synced media table.
novel_features.why_it_matters: Use when you have a content item or product and need its actual image URL.

narrative.headline: A read-only, offline-first mirror and search engine for the public NiSi Italia filter catalog and content.
narrative.value_prop: Sync every public product, category, attribute, post, page, and media item into a local SQLite database, then search and browse it offline with agent-clean output. Includes a filter-finder (filters) that surfaces available sizes/types, an enriched priced shop view (shop), a clean content reader (read), and a catalog digest (digest) — all without authentication.

quickstart.comment: Confirm the store is reachable before syncing
Mirror the catalog and content into the local SQLite store
Offline full-text search across products and content
Scan the catalog by price with categories and stock

troubleshoots.fix: Run 'nisifilters-pp-cli sync' first; these read the local mirror, not the live site.

troubleshoots.symptom: image shows no URL for a post
troubleshoots.fix: Sync media too: 'nisifilters-pp-cli sync' mirrors media so featured images resolve.
Sync products and product attributes first; the finder reads the local mirror.

narrative.when_to_use: Use this CLI to read, search, or mirror the public NiSi Italia store and content from the terminal or an agent: the filter catalog (ND, GND, polarizers, holders, kits), product categories and attributes, prices and stock, and Academy posts and pages. It is ideal for offline, scriptable, agent-clean catalog access without scraping the storefront.
anti_triggers: Do not use this CLI to place orders, manage a cart, or check out — it only reads public product listings.
Do not use it to create, edit, or delete content — it is strictly read-only.
Do not use it for stores other than nisifilters.it; the base URL is fixed.
